summary: Read a list of stock prices, with each index standing for one trading day. You may complete many buy then sell cycles, but you hold at most one share at a time and must sell before you buy again. The day after a sale forbids a purchase, so you skip that day and may buy only on a later day. Under these limits, find the largest profit and write it. Doing no trade at all may leave the profit at zero.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
